criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General Information Request
categories.definition: Requests for general information about COVID-19, including what it is and how it spreads.

categories.name: Symptoms and Health Concerns
categories.definition: Inquiries about symptoms, health concerns, and personal health situations related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Prevention and Safety Measures
categories.definition: Questions about how to prevent COVID-19 and stay safe, including hygiene practices and social distancing.

categories.name: Treatment and Cure
categories.definition: Requests for information about treatments, cures, and vaccines for COVID-19.

categories.name: Transmission and Risk Factors
categories.definition: Inquiries about how COVID-19 is transmitted and what factors increase risk.

categories.name: Travel and Transportation
categories.definition: Questions about travel restrictions, safety of travel, and transportation-related concerns.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: Requests for the latest news, updates, and statistics about COVID-19.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: Inquiries about myths, misinformation, and debunked claims related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Donations and Support
categories.definition: Requests for information on how to donate or support COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Sharing Information
categories.definition: Requests to share information, reports, or services related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: Expressions of greetings, gratitude, or appreciation towards the service or bot.

categories.name: Miscellaneous
categories.definition: Other inquiries or statements that do not fit into the above categories.
